definitions.gloss: storefront, shop front, store display area
definitions.explanation: The front area of a store, especially the display area visible from outside or the area where products are displayed for customers. Also refers to in-store retail as opposed to online sales.

examples.japanese: {店頭|てんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: New products are lined up on the store shelves.

examples.japanese: {店頭|てんとう}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In-store prices are often higher than online.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{店頭|てんとう}{販売|はんばい}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧で、⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: That limited-edition product is only available for in-store purchase; it cannot be bought online.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used to contrast in-store retail with online sales: {店頭|てんとう}{販売|はんばい} (in-store sales) vs. ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (online sales). In finance, {店頭|てんとう}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧ refers to over-the-counter (OTC) trading. The word emphasizes the physical retail space where customers interact with products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店頭|てんとう}{販売|はんばい}: in-store sales
- {店頭|てんとう}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: in-store price
- {店頭|てんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: be on store shelves
- {店頭|てんとう}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: over-the-counter trading (finance)
